groups.rationale: Antithesis harness generates a synthetic SSH host CA with the other synthetic secrets and configures both Marshall replicas with MARSHALL_SSH_HOST_TRUST like the NixOS module so Porsche can obtain its host certificate; reviewed and updated 17-reference.md. No Marshall code change.
